# ADR-005: Keep physics ownership and snapshot differences visible

Status: observed_design_with_open_parity_gap

Concerns: Q-state, Q-order

## Decision

Retain observed Avian f64 ownership and explicit synchronization configuration; do not claim original collision or snapshot parity from it.

## Rationale

The runtime already contains validated local work. Complete algorithm correspondence requires additional source-bound generation and evidence.

## Alternatives

Replace all physics immediately; treat Avian behavior as original behavior.

## Consequences

Controller traces, double-integration prevention and complete future-state restore relations remain acceptance blockers.
